comment: Maps a vcpkg port name to the CPE 2.3 vendor and product of the upstream project.
vcpkg records no CPEs, and Dependency-Track can only scan CPEs, so the attribution
generator composes one from this table and the port version.
brotli, fontconfig and icu were looked up in the NVD CPE dictionary at
copied from the matching qt_attribution.json under qtbase/src/3rdparty.
Never guess an entry: the obvious icu:icu and fontconfig:fontconfig both match nothing in
NVD, and a CPE that matches nothing produces a clean scan that means nothing. A port that
is absent here gets no CPE at all, which is the safe outcome.
